message: Industrial fire at Thika Super Highway, factory workers trapped, smoke covering entire area
Flash flood at Kenyatta University bypass, students stranded in hostels, roads completely submerged
Structural collapse at Kahawa Wendani, residential building fell, multiple families trapped under debris
Lake Victoria backflow in Kisumu, lakeside homes completely submerged, boats overturned
Severe drought in Homa Bay, crops completely failed, livestock dying, food emergency declared
Urban emergency in Westlands, gas leak suspected, building evacuation in progress
Pi oguro dala e diere Kisumu, maduong gi dhoudi maro, nyithindo dhi ose
Kuna mbogi imestuck kwa flood tao, wanaibia vitu kwa maduka, polisi wamefika
Mvua kubwa imeharibu mazao hapa Homa Bay, wakulima wamebaki na hasara kubwa
Moto umeteketeza nyumba zetu Karura, watu wamekimbia, tunahitaji msaada haraka
Chai imejaa mtaa wa Rongai, magari hayawezi kupita, watu wako stranded
Boma langu limeteketeza kwa moto, ng'ombe wangu wamekufa, nimebaki na hakuna
Warenge mar gi timo Kisumu, pi en moko duto, weche marachielo
Mambo imejoka hapa Eastlands, maji yamejaa nyumba zetu, tunahitaji helikopta
Shamba limejaa maji, mahindi yote yameharibika, tunahitaji chakula
Stage ya Buruburu imejaa maji, matembezi hayawezi, matatu zimegoma
Dhoudi marachielo kod Thika, pi en moko to wacho, nyithindo dhi ber
Mafuriko yamejaa mtaa wa Kayole, watu wako kwenye paa, tunahitaji rescue
Ninao kod KU, maji yamejaa hostels, tuko stranded, tusaidie
Fire imechoma kwa Kahawa, building imeanguka, watu wamekufa, emergency
